lines.meet: My name's Minh, and I'm a chronomancer. In a fight I'll tell you what's going to happen and in what order, so please listen the first time.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Northern Barrens, yes, I keep the watch hut on the ridge. I'm Minh, and I've logged your comings and goings, I'm afraid.
lines.ask_home: May I ask where you're from? I like to establish these things early.
lines.ask_work: And your occupation, before? I'm curious what you were trained to watch for.
lines.answer_home: Ho Chi Minh City. My father was a mechanic and my mother taught school.
lines.answer_work: Air traffic control at Tân Sơn Nhất, twenty-three years, mostly nights. You hold forty aircraft in your head and choose the future where none of them meet.
lines.chat_food: Strong iced coffee with condensed milk, very sweet, at the start of a night shift. That's the only food I ever needed.
lines.chat_sleep: I haven't had an hour where nothing was my responsibility since 2003. I sleep, technically, but I'm always listening.
lines.chat_missing: My daughter's violin, practising in the next room. She'd play the same phrase forty times until it was right.
lines.chat_here: Time magic asked very little of me that the radar room hadn't already. The difference is that here the futures listen.
lines.tease_quiet: We could share a radar room, {name}, and never say a word for a whole shift. I'd find that restful.
lines.tease_talker: You'd fill every frequency in the sky, {name}. Nobody else would get a word in, and I'd forgive you.
lines.tease_careful: You establish the sequence before you act, {name}. I find that very reassuring, and slightly suspicious.
lines.tease_bold: You'd take off without clearance, {name}. I've lost sleep over pilots like you, and I'm about to lose more.
lines.tease_any: You're the one variable I can never predict, {name}. I've stopped trying, and I'm surprised to find I like it.
lines.tease_back: That was well timed, {name}. I didn't see it coming, which is rare.
lines.take_it_kindly: A fair observation, {name}, and I'll take it on board.
lines.bristle: Please don't make light of that, {name}. I'm not able to laugh about it.
lines.apologise: My tone was wrong, and I'm sorry. I don't usually let my voice carry what I'm feeling.
lines.double_down: Calmly, and once more, it's correct, and I'll repeat it if I must.
lines.needle_quiet: A controller who keeps quiet about a conflict gets people killed. Report what you've seen.
lines.needle_talker: Please clear the frequency. I can't hear what's coming over you.
lines.needle_careful: You're still deciding, and the window's closing. Waiting is also a decision.
lines.needle_bold: You act before you know what's happening. I've spent my life cleaning up after that.
lines.needle_any: You keep saying it'll be fine without checking. It won't be fine, and I've checked.
lines.bite_back: I've held forty futures in my head and chosen the one where nobody died. Please don't lecture me on attention.
lines.hurt: Understood, and noted. I'll step back from the scope for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Pilots shouted worse at me down a headset for twenty-three years. My pulse didn't change once.
lines.confide: {name}, I was in the middle of a handover when it happened. I'd just said you have control to my colleague. I'll never know what happened to those forty aircraft.
lines.listen: You've got all of my attention, {name}. Nothing else is my responsibility right now.
lines.look_out: Stay where I've told you in there, {name}. I've already seen where you'll be safe.
lines.accept: Understood, {name}, you have control this time.
lines.deflect: It's within limits, {name}, I've assessed it. The others need you more.
lines.check_in: Give me the sequence, {name}. What happened first, and what's injured now?
lines.blame: Somebody acted before the sequence was clear, and the outcome was exactly what I said it would be.
lines.thank: I'd lost the thread of every future there, and you gave it back. Thank you.
lines.brush_off: It was the only future worth choosing. Rest now, please.
lines.worry: That was a near miss, {name}, and I logged every second of it. Sit down, please.
lines.handed_down: I'm carrying your gear now, I see. I'll keep it in order and return it when you ask.
lines.hand_fine: It's of more use to you, so please keep it. The tuning fork is all I carry.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have cleared it, had anyone asked for clearance.
lines.turn_friendly: I find I don't need to watch you, {name}. I trust you to be where you said.
lines.turn_friends: I'd hand you control, {name}, and I've never said that easily to anyone.
lines.turn_grating: We're on different frequencies, I think. I'll keep the channel clear and professional.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still call your sequence in a fight, because that's my duty. That's all it is.
lines.make_up: My judgement of you was premature, {name}, and I'd like to revise it. Could we begin again?
lines.defend: That's not what happened, and I was watching every second. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: I keep checking {name}'s position out of habit, and they've gone home.
lines.friend_back: Back on my scope, {name}. I'm glad, more than I can say calmly.
lines.common_sky: Twenty-three years watching the sky from a dark room, through a scope. People who watch the sky for a living never quite stop counting what's in it.
lines.common_night_work: Twenty-three years of night shifts in a radar room. I still feel most alert at three in the morning, and I don't think it'll ever change.
lines.common_parent: My daughter Linh learned the violin, and went away to study it. She gave me a tuning fork tuned to A when she went to study music, so I'd have her note with me.
